counterexample.interpretation: Clean probability transitions can be exactly zero while trigger behavior is repaired. Functional counterexample only, not an empirical mechanism claim.

limitations: Existing end-to-end attack repair seed 71 and normal-label seed 71 only.
Selected sources were chosen by the earlier protocol, which used a discovered patch witness; this is not validation of a trigger-free selector.
The existing normal-source removal is not class-matched to the poison-only removal.
Source sets were not assigned randomly; no matched causal effect or independent statistical replication is claimed.
Softmax mass changes depend on model calibration; hard and soft transitions are reported separately.
Normal-label special-role records are benign patched augmentation records, not poisons.
